easy.def: The part along the side of something.
examples: Do not stand at the edge.
The edge of the table is sharp.
We sat at the edge of the pool.

more.def: The outer line or border of something, where it stops.
examples: He stood at the edge of the cliff and looked down.
Keep your cup away from the edge of the table.
The knife has a very sharp edge.
I felt edgy before the test.
He was edgy.
An edgy cat.
I felt edgy before the big spelling test.
The cat was edgy during the thunderstorm.
She got edgy when she had to wait so long.
These berries are edible.
The cake is edible.
Not every plant is edible.
The tiny blue berries are edible.
Are the flowers on the cake edible?
Hikers must know which mushrooms are edible.

easy.def: To fix and improve your writing.
examples: I edit my story.
She edited her report.
Let's edit the video.

more.def: To read and make changes to a piece of writing, a picture or a video to fix mistakes and make it better.
examples: We edited our stories to fix spelling mistakes before we shared them.
He edited the video to make it shorter.
My mom edits the class newsletter every month.

easy.def: One printing of a book or paper.
examples: I have the first edition.
The Sunday edition is big.
This is a new edition.

more.def: One version of a book, newspaper or magazine that is printed at one time.
examples: The library has a rare first edition.
The Sunday edition of the paper is big.
This is the latest edition of the dictionary.

easy.def: A person who fixes and prepares writing before it is published.
examples: The editor read the story.
The editor corrected the mistakes.
The newspaper editor wrote a note.

more.def: A person who checks and improves writing before it is printed.
examples: The editor fixed the spelling in the article.
The book's editor helped the author.
The newspaper editor chose the headlines.
Schools educate children.
She educated her class.
Teachers educate us.

more.def: To teach someone, usually at a school, so that they learn what they need to know.
examples: Schools educate children in reading, math and science.
The museum helps educate visitors about animals.
Parents work to educate their children about being safe.
A good education is important.
She got her education at the school.
Education helps you learn.

more.def: The process of learning and teaching, such as at school.
examples: A good education helps you get a good job.
The town built a new school for the education of its children.
She works in education as a teacher.
An educational show.
The trip was educational.
I like educational games.

more.def: Teaching you something or helping you learn.
examples: We watched an educational show about space.
The trip to the museum was educational.
I like educational games that teach math.
My mom is an educator.
The educator taught.
An educator helps kids learn.

more.def: A person whose job is to teach others, such as a teacher.
examples: My aunt is an educator at the high school.
The educator taught us how to read maps.
An educator helps students learn new things.
